cohort: Pregnant women who underwent routine second-trimester anomaly screening scans at West Middlesex University Hospital, London, UK, between 2012 and 2016
finding: Routine screening for vasa previa in a UK population yielded a 100% detection rate and a vasa previa incidence of approximately 1:1300 pregnancies.
mod_finding: Of the 19 patients with confirmed vasa previa, 17 had scheduled cesarean deliveries, and two required emergency deliveries due to antepartum hemorrhage.
